title: Like button
summary: A like button that doesn't light up, and won't un-like.
hints: Look at the function the like buttons call: the branch that likes a post and the branch that un-likes one.
Liking changes the list React already holds and hands that same list back, so React sees nothing new and doesn't show the change. Un-liking keeps the clicked post and throws away every other one.
Treat state as read-only: always give React a brand-new array. To like, copy the old list with the new post added; to un-like, keep every post except the clicked one.
